screens.name: P0 — Global Status
screens.description: Four groups: identity + current flow, the walking dots, the since-reset pair, then network and LED.

screens.name: P1 — Instant Flow
screens.description: Two columns of four. One self-describing element per sensor; the unit is in the header, as on every telemetry page.

screens.name: P2 — Cumulative Volume
screens.description: Two columns of four on P1's grid, in m3. Absorbs the old litres page: 1 L = 0.001 m3, so one page carries both readings.

screens.name: P3 — Session Volume
screens.description: Session volume in m3. Absorbs the old session-litres page for the same reason.

screens.name: P4 — Max Flow Since Reset
screens.description: Per-channel peaks since the last session reset, with MAX marking a channel that hit its q_max ceiling — i.e. a sensor under-dimensioned for its pipe.

screens.name: P5 — Enter Configuration
screens.description: A prompt, not a menu. The body says what Configuration contains; the footer says the gesture. Neither repeats the other.

screens.name: Nyquist Validation Warning
screens.description: Shown when f_theoretical exceeds Nyquist limit. UP=Edit, DOWN=Save anyway.

screens.name: Idle (display off)
screens.description: Backlight off state. Any button press returns to Info mode.

screens.name: CFG.M — Modbus
screens.description: Config root entry CFG.M. ENTER descends into the Modbus level: slave address, baud rate, parity and stop bits.

screens.name: CFG.D — Display
screens.description: Config root entry CFG.D. ENTER descends into the Display level: the LED pulse settings and the unit the panel shows flows in.

screens.name: CFG.S — Sensors
screens.description: Config root entry C7. ENTER opens the sensor selector, where UP/DOWN pages through the eight channels and ENTER opens the settings of the one shown.

screens.name: C.BACK — Back
screens.description: Ascends one level, out of Configuration. — laid out to the §7 back template.

screens.name: M1 — Modbus ID
screens.description: TEMPLATE for every setting page. Title names the setting, so the value needs no label; the range gives context before editing.

screens.name: M1.V — Edit Modbus ID
screens.description: TEMPLATE for every value editor. New above Saved, aligned on one column so the change is directly comparable.

screens.name: M2 — Baud Rate
screens.description: Config root entry C2. ENTER descends; UP/DOWN move within the level. — laid out to the §7 setting template.

screens.name: M2.V — Edit Baud Rate
screens.description: Value editor for C2. ENTER commits and ascends; hold ENTER discards. — laid out to the §7 editor template.

screens.name: P6 — Factory Reset
screens.description: The warning names everything preferences.clear() erases, including the network provisioning the old text omitted. No page number in the title.

screens.name: Reset totals?
screens.description: Confirm screen. ENTER-short is unattached and ignored; ENTER held 3000 ms confirms, and releasing early abandons the countdown. UP/DOWN pages to < BACK.
